mbm-0168.clue: The map has a coffee stain where the lift starts.
mbm-0168.quote: I skied to the lodge door on a freezing morning and someone handed me a cup through the little ticket window. I marked the spot on my trail map with the bottom of the cup. Nobody needs a legend for that.

mbm-0169.clue: We clap for the person holding the antenna.
mbm-0169.quote: The picture goes clear if you hold our rabbit ears just so. We take turns standing in our pajamas with one arm up. After the last ad we applaud whoever brought us the ending.

mbm-0170.clue: Mine are the pajamas with drawn-on pockets.
mbm-0170.quote: I colored a pretend pocket on my pajama top for movie night. My niece saw it and drew me a tiny pretend ticket to keep there. Her ticket admits one grown-up and any number of cookies.

mbm-0171.clue: See the speck of blue chalk on that hold?
mbm-0171.quote: I spent three Fridays getting past the same bulge on the climbing wall. My friend cheered so hard when I made it that his blue chalk bag burst. It snowed inside the gym.

mbm-0172.clue: I like the step before the music starts.
mbm-0172.quote: My partner squeezes my hand once when she hears the waltz coming. The first time we got our turn just right, the hem of her skirt brushed the very last chair without moving it.

mbm-0173.quote: We made my grandpa a quilt he could recognize without his glasses. The corner with the ridged corduroy is his old jacket. He always puts that corner nearest his chin.

mbm-0174.quote: My anime club records our own sound effects. I walked two coconut shells across a baking tray for a robot parade. We had to stop the tape because everyone could hear me laughing.

mbm-0175.clue: I keep a shell next to the score.
mbm-0175.quote: When our beach-volleyball scores get muddled, we move shells between two buckets. Once a hermit crab picked up a point and took it down the beach. We called a very short timeout.

mbm-0176.clue: My sky starts in the puddle.
mbm-0176.quote: I painted a row of buildings from their reflection in a rain puddle. A cyclist went past halfway through. I liked the wobbly windows enough to keep them.

mbm-0177.clue: I always use the yellow yarn last.
mbm-0177.quote: I crocheted a bus for my cousin, right down to the little door. We used yellow for the headlights. She drives it to bed every night and turns the lamps off with her thumb.

mbm-0178.clue: I can draw the lake with my eyes shut.
mbm-0178.quote: Under my open parachute I could see the whole bend of the lake I learned to swim in. I traced it in the air with one finger, then drew it in the dirt after I landed.

mbm-0179.clue: My landing photo has a purple stripe.
mbm-0179.quote: The wind laid my canopy across the grass in a perfect purple curve. My friend lined up the camera so the hillside looked as if it were smiling. I’m the small dot in the dimple.

mbm-0180.clue: I count my laps in coffee cups.
mbm-0180.quote: I swim the first lane while my friend opens the pool café. When I turn my head to breathe I can see her stacking cups. I finish when the stack reaches the window latch.

mbm-0181.clue: There’s flour on the practice mat.
mbm-0181.quote: My sister came to watch our forms straight from the bakery. After class she pressed my feet into flour and showed me the outline of my stance. I stood straighter the second time.

mbm-0182.clue: That patch is the color of a broken crayon.
mbm-0182.quote: I saved my nephew’s wax rubbing of a tree and pieced the bark in brown cloth. He insists the knot in the middle is a bear’s nose. I stitched him a little felt bear to prove him right.

mbm-0183.clue: I let the paint go past the edge.
mbm-0183.quote: I painted the view from a train on three envelopes. Line them up and the river winds across all three. My mum got the middle section and had to phone my brothers for the banks.

mbm-0184.clue: I always photograph the candles twice.
mbm-0184.quote: This year I set the camera timer, blew out my birthday candles and sat perfectly still for the second picture. The first photo has a row of flames. In the second the smoke painted stripes across my sweater all by itself.

mbm-0185.clue: I need two bookmarks for this one.
mbm-0185.quote: My sister and I read the same adventure at different speeds. I use a red ribbon, she uses green. When they meet, we get to talk about that chapter over breakfast.

mbm-0186.clue: The spoon is hanging above the sink.
mbm-0186.quote: I won a tomato-soup contest by tipping the bowl for the last sip. The prize was a wooden spoon nearly as tall as I am. I carried it home on the bus like a flag.

mbm-0187.clue: It’s the quietest thunder you’ll ever hear.
mbm-0187.quote: I shake a sheet of tin backstage for thunderstorms. At dress rehearsal a real storm started up outside. We traded thunderclaps for half the second act and nobody noticed.

mbm-0188.clue: My helmet has a tiny leaf print.
mbm-0188.quote: On the calm stretch of our rafting trip a maple leaf landed in my helmet vent. It rode two rapids with me. At the takeout I pressed it in our logbook under the route map.

mbm-0189.clue: The moon has one loose button.
mbm-0189.quote: I made the moon for our play out of an old lamp shade and silver cloth. It rises on a cord. If it catches on the curtain I cough once and the stage manager gives it a nudge.

mbm-0190.clue: I visit the drawer with the handles.
mbm-0190.quote: Our local museum lets you open a drawer of old keys. The smallest key has a painted blue ribbon and no label. That little mystery keeps me coming back more than the crown does.

mbm-0191.clue: I learned to count with buttons.
mbm-0191.quote: My neighbor taught me crochet with four buttons in a saucer. We moved one after each row. When I finished the pouch, we sewed all four buttons onto it.

mbm-0192.clue: I’ve got the seat number memorized.
mbm-0192.quote: When the old cinema closed, I bought one velvet seat at the sale. It lives by my window now. For the price of a sandwich I can watch the whole street go by.
